high_level_description: This image is a still from the animated film "The Nightmare Before Christmas." It features two main characters: Jack Skellington, the protagonist, and Sally, his love interest. Characters: Jack Skellington: He is on the left side of the image. He has dark hair and is dressed in a brown suit with a white shirt and a bow tie. His expression appears to be one of surprise or concern as he looks at Sally. Sally: She is on the right side of the image. She has long black hair adorned with a crown-like accessory and is wearing a white dress
